security.paragraph: Sales data is sensitive. BellumAI handles it to the standards expected of a European B2B tool.

items.title: Hosted in Europe

items.title: GDPR compliant

items.q: Where does BellumAI get its information?
items.a: BellumAI cross-checks more than 20 sources, starting with the official registers: INSEE, INPI, BODACC, France Travail, public tenders (BOAMP, DECP) — then company websites and job postings, the press and web signals. Every insight is sourced and traceable — nothing is made up.

items.q: How is this different from a CRM or a scraping tool?
items.a: A CRM stores what you already know; a scraping tool drowns you in raw data. BellumAI does the analysis work: it prioritizes accounts, identifies decision-makers, detects buying signals and hands you a ready-to-use action plan. Then it exports to your CRM.

items.q: How long does it take to get an account brief?
items.a: About 10 minutes per account, versus half a day to a full day of manual research. You type a company name, and BellumAI assembles contacts, org chart, recent signals and recommended messages.

items.q: Is my data — and my prospects' data — protected?
items.a: Yes. Hosting in the European Union, GDPR compliance, encryption in transit and at rest, strict per-account isolation (RLS). We never resell your data. A DPA is available on request.

items.q: Do I need to install anything or train the team?
items.a: No. BellumAI is a web app: you log in and launch your first analysis in minutes. The interface is designed for salespeople, not data analysts.

items.q: Does BellumAI integrate with my tools?
items.a: Yes: export to HubSpot and Salesforce, notifications to Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Google Chat, Mattermost or webhook, and a connection to your AI assistant (Claude, Cursor) via the MCP protocol. Each connection is switched on from Settings › Integrations.

items.q: Can I try before I pay?
items.a: Yes: we walk you through a demo on a real account of your choice. You see the dossier Bellum produces, the contacts it finds and the action plan it proposes, before any decision.
